result:
The gun kick (cw-gunkick) shipped earlier as v34.73. I didn't run anything this time, and two items are missing.

- **What shipped:** a shot pushes the pixel-look body back 1 art pixel, or 2 for shotgun, magnum, sniper, DMR and lance. EFFECT INTENSITY HALF keeps 1 pixel and OFF gives none. The linked window shows it, because it reads the muzzle value passed to the draw.
- **Checks:** the ship's checks covered rest, rifle, shotgun, sniper, half and off.
- **No frame numbers:** I didn't measure 4K frame cost. The change is an offset on the existing body draw (one subtraction per body, no new draw), so there is nothing to put on the quality ladder.
- **No before/after pictures:** the muzzle value lasts 0.06 s and the camera has no mid-shot stage, so a screenshot can't catch the kick.
- **Watch on next play:** SMG fire should read as a steady 1 px lean, not jitter. A shotgun should step back 2 px.

TASK DONE
